title: Is There an App That Tells Me What to Do on My Farm Today?
metaTitle: What to Do on My Farm Today: An App That Plans Each Day
metaDescription: Asking what to do on my farm today? anee.io shows each lot's tasks, stage and weather every morning and emails the plan at 6 AM. See how it works.
focusKeyword: what to do on my farm today
keywords: what to do on my farm today
excerpt: Yes. If you keep asking what to do on my farm today, anee.io, a farm app built for Filipino farmers, answers it every morning. Each lot shows its tasks, growth stage, watch list and weather, dated from its own planting day, and the plan reaches your team by email at 6 AM. If you would rather not plan at all, let Anee, the smart farm technician, run Anee Auto on credits: she writes the whole season and moves tasks when rain comes.

blocks.text:
Good timing is most of farming. Sound rice management sets key checks for each growth stage and tracks the work and results stage by stage. It also starts with a walk through the field early every morning. The weather adds its own part: schedule fertilizer and pesticide work for suitable weather, and watch your crops for pests, disease and moisture stress.

That is a lot to keep in your head for one lot, and harder for five lots planted on different days. A daily plan app does the counting, so you can do the work.

blocks.text: How anee.io answers what to do on my farm today

Each lot keeps its own day zero, the day it was sown or transplanted. So a task written as day 21 after transplanting lands on the right date for each lot, even when you planted the lots a week apart. When the rain comes, drag a task to another day, and the board keeps the record for your reports.

Start the season from a protocol you wrote in the [Protocol Builder](/features/protocol-builder), from Anee's Crop Protocol Analysis, or from scratch. The [daily farm tasks](/features/daily-farm-tasks) board then shows each day, and the [morning plan email](/features/morning-plan-email) sends it to your team. Offline mode keeps the board working where there is no signal, and your changes sync later.
How do you set it up?

items.title: Sign up free
items.text: Create an account. The free Libre plan holds one active season, enough to try a full crop.

items.title: Add your lots
items.text: Give each field its crop, variety, size, place and day zero. Trace it on the map if you like.

items.title: Load the season's tasks
items.text: Pick a protocol, ask Anee for a Crop Protocol Analysis, or write tasks yourself, counted in days after sowing or transplanting.

items.title: Add your team
items.text: On Solo Farmer, keep a roster of workers and put them on tasks. Farm Owner adds a login for each of them.

items.title: Open Today each morning
items.text: Tick what is done, mark who worked, and add a photo or a voice note. Move what the weather will not allow.

blocks.text: Or let Anee Auto plan it for you

Rather not plan at all? Answer a few questions once: your lots, the crop and variety, your soil, your water, your fertilizer and your workers. Anee looks up your variety, reads the forecast and the season ahead, and writes every task from land preparation to harvest. Then she keeps it on track every day.

Today's work comes every morning, by email too, for you and each worker. If a task cannot happen today, she moves it to the best day near it. Send her a photo, a video or a voice note from the field, and she adjusts the plan. Anee Auto uses credits.

blocks.title: The plan is only as good as day zero
blocks.text: Enter the real sowing or transplanting date of each lot. If a lot runs ahead of or behind its calendar, [Realign by Anee](/features/realign-by-anee) reads its records, its weather and your notes, then moves that lot's stage count to match. It uses credits.

blocks.text: Questions about a daily farm plan app

items.q: Does the app know what to do with my crop?
items.a: anee.io knows the growth stages of 85 Philippine crops, from palay and mais to vegetables and fruit trees. For each lot it shows the stage, what to do now and what to watch for. The tasks come from your protocol, from Anee's analysis or from Anee Auto.

items.q: Can my workers get the plan without the app?
items.a: Yes. The morning plan email goes out at 6 AM with what to do and on which lot. You can also share the plan, one day or one task as a public link that anyone can open with no login.

items.q: What happens when it rains on a spray day?
items.a: The weather sits beside the plan, and anee.io reminds you when rain falls on a spray day. Drag the task to a better day, or let Anee Auto move it for you.
Yes. Offline mode is always on, so you can tick tasks and write notes in the field. Your changes sync when the signal comes back, but Anee needs internet.
